t: The $(2)Custom Mode$() is the most versatile of all the modes, as it allows a force field of any shape or structure to be projected. Once a user-defined block pattern has been analysed and stored by the $(2)Custom Mode$() item itself, the Projector is able to generate a force field that is an $(9)exact replica$() of the original. In this manner, force fields may be constructed in the shape of $(9)anything that can be crafted$() - including a bridge, a house, or even an entire fortress!
$(2)自定义模式$()是所有模式中功能最全面的一种，它允许投射任意形状或结构的力场。当$(2)自定义模式$()物品自身完成对用户自定义方块图案的分析与存储后，力场投影仪即可生成一个与原始图案$(9)完全一致的复制品$()。通过这种方式，力场可被构造成$(9)任何可合成物品$()的形状——包括桥梁、房屋，甚至整座要塞！

Hold the $(2)Custom Mode$() item and use it on two blocks in the world. These two (primary and secondary) blocks will define a 3D space that the $(2)Custom Mode$() can analyse. As each block is clicked on, their coordinates in the world will be stored as 'Primary pos' and 'Secondary pos'. Use while sneaking to instruct the $(2)Custom Mode$() item to analyze and save all the blocks that exist between the selected points.
手持$(2)自定义模式$()物品，在世界中对两个方块使用该物品。这两个方块（主坐标点与次坐标点）将共同定义一个三维空间，供$(2)自定义模式$()进行分析。每次点击方块时，其在世界中的坐标将分别被记录为“主坐标”与“次坐标”。按住潜行键（Shift）再使用该物品，可指示$(2)自定义模式$()物品分析并保存所选两点之间存在的全部方块。

When the Projector detects that a $(2)Custom Mode$() item has been entered into the correct slot, random holograms will continuously appear above it to indicate that the field pattern does not match any of the known mode shapes (this is a feature, not a bug). If desired, set where the force field should appear (in relation to the Projector) by adding $(l:mffs:projector_modules/translation_module)$(5)Translation Modules$() into the item slots marked by directional arrows.
当力场投影仪检测到$(2)自定义模式$()物品已正确置入对应插槽时，投射器上方将持续随机浮现全息影像，以此提示当前力场图案与已知任一模式形状均不匹配（此为正常功能，非程序错误）。如需设定力场相对于投射器的出现位置，可在带有方向箭头标记的物品槽中添加$(l:mffs:projector_modules/translation_module)$(5)位移模块$()。

As with the other projector modes, $(2)Custom Mode$() force fields can be rotated and scaled using the $(l:mffs:projector_modules/rotation_module)$(5)Rotation$() and $(l:mffs:upgrade_modules/scale_module)$(5)Scale Modules$() respectively.
与其他投射器模式一样，$(2)自定义模式$()力场也可通过$(l:mffs:projector_modules/rotation_module)$(5)旋转模块$()和$(l:mffs:upgrade_modules/scale_module)$(5)扩展模块$()分别进行旋转与缩放。
一个$(2)自定义模式$()力场正在被投射。
A $(2)Custom Mode$() field being projected with a $(l:mffs:projector_modules/camouflage_module)$(5)Camouflage Module$() applied.
一个正在投射的$(2)自定义模式$()力场，已安装$(l:mffs:projector_modules/camouflage_module)$(5)伪装模块$()。
